mapper.select: SELECT ri.ingredient_id, i.name AS ingredient_name, ri.unit, SUM(CAST(ri.quantity AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS total_quantity FROM meal_plan mp JOIN recipe_ingredient ri ON ri.recipe_id = mp.recipe_id JOIN ingredient i ON i.id = ri.ingredient_id WHERE mp.plan_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ri.ingredient_id, ri.unit, i.name ORDER BY i.name
